name: compact-download-expand-animation
title: Fix compact download expand animation
description: Fix the compact icon to full panel animation being skipped when a download or foreground task starts from compact mode.
creator: Mabel-WIN
notes: Diagnosis reviewed with Claude: prepareMainWindowForForegroundTask starts animated forceFull, then stale isMinimizedRef can call ensureMainWindowFullMode, whose instant panel transition clobbers the first full render.
